title: Need! More! Toast!
author: Adam Biltcliffe
description: In this one-room game, you play as someone who's made eight slices of toast and put them all, from largest to smallest, on one of two plates glued to the counter. Naturally, you must sit to eat, and of course, toast only belongs on a plate. Can you move all the slices, one by one, to a plate on the table, without making any unbalanced stacks of toast?
